content: Vatane wanugan ware wo Yesus aubaisy
Yahudi awa ono wo rotijo ragije mewen daije raisye nandea mararai to. One so rawainamo Ono Paska.
Naije syeno akokoe utantuna no Yavaro Amisye rai muno kuruno makari mbaro Ananyao Musa raije wo unanuije rakani indamu wo Yesus aubaisy. Ware wo aijar maninimbe, weye wo vatano wanuije masyaniv.
Umba naije Anakakai Akoe siso Yudas, apa tamo akoe mi Iskariot, anuga rai. Yudas sopamo siso irati Yesus apa arakovo abusyinara eane rurum utavondi aije mansai.

Weti Yudas poroto no syeno akokoe utantuna no Yavaro Amisye raije nawe, akarijo naito Yahudi wo Yavaro Amisye ramane nawe mansai. Umba wayao vambinibe animaisye mirati Yudas po rave ramu po Yesus amavun nanto mai.
Weti syeno akokoe muno nait akari umawe manayanambe ti wurairive ware wo doije inta raunanto Yudas ai.
Yudas pare yombe, umba po varore rakani indamu po Yesus amavuno mansai maninimbe indamu vemo vatano wanuije wo raen inya.
Yesus apa arakove yo anaisyo Paska ratayao
Naije Ono Paska ndea mamaisy arono vatano Yahudi wo rotijo ragije mewen daije raisy muno wo domba inta aubaisy wo ameseo Amisye ai umba wo ama ine raisy.
Arono naije Yesus po Petrusa pe Yohanesa pe yatutir pare, “Ita ipo anaisyo Paska ratayao indamu wandaisy.”
Umba yo anajo yare, “Injae, rui rati nyare mbekero ririmo anaisyo Paska ratayao wansai?”
Umba Yesus po raura akananto yai pare, “Wurisisa no Yerusalem, ripare rinanta vatane inta ai, opamo po mana rawavino kiviro kopa rai ti po raugav. Wiritavono ai, ita no apa yavaro pare siso ri.
Umba ipo raura irati vatano apave yavare rai ai ipare, ‘Injayo Kurune po nanajo pare nya tanoano rui mirati Wepe apa arakovo utavondi aije nawe wo anaisyo Paska raisyo rai?’

Indati vatane umaso po tanoano vono warae ama uga manakoe inta rarorono isai. Tanoane umaso mamai bintabo irati meja muno ananuge kotaro isyi daije rautan. Weti ripo anaisye ratayao wansamarom no naije.”
Umba Petrusa pe Yohanesa pe yurija no Yerusalem. No ratuije nyanta irati anakotaro uma Yesus po raura we rai mamai bintabo. Umba yo anaisyo Paska ratayao ti ntuna.
Yesusa pe apa arakovo utavondi aije nawe wo anaisyo Ono Paska raisy
Arono uma pasyo kobe ti Ono Paska mamai to, naije Yesusa pe apa arakovo utavondi aije nawe waje utantuna tenambe indamu wisyisy.
Umba Yesus po raura mai pare, “Risyamo ibeke dave ituna wamisyi tenambe irati Ono Paska so rai, arono Sya siurijo mangke mana nande rainye so.
Syo raura tugaive: indati Syo Ono Paska raisy akatoe ramu gao Amisye de be akarive Apa kawasae mai no mine vone so ti wamanugan wamo Apa ono akoe raisy akato.”
Umba Yesus po mokijo anggurije raijade, Po kove raura seo Amisye ai, umba Po raura pare, “Wapo anggurije so raugav muno wapo ratodijo wasai indamu wadamanam.
Syo raura tugaive, indati Syo anggurije inta ramanam akatoe ramu gao Amisye de be akarive Apa kawasae mai no mine vone so.”

Naije Yesus po rotije raijade umba Po kove raura seo Amisye ai. Umba Po raporadi muno Po ratodijo Apa arakovo utavondi aije mai, umba Po raura pare, “Somamo inanasine mi so, omamo Syo raunande wasai. Wapo rotije so raisy indamu wasaemen irati Rinai.”

Maisyare omai tavon, arono wo anaisyo Paska umaso raisya mewen, umba Yesus po mokijo anggurije raijade akato, umba Po raura pare, “Somamo Sya mavugo nsororopo wasaije mi som, mo Amisye apa urairijo wanyine raokaisy.
Weramu vatano po inamavune pi pe wantantuna wamisyi tenambe no meja so.
Tugae, Risy, Arikainyo Vatan, indati ikakai mamaisyo Amisye apa bekere rai, weramu kakaije nde irati vatano po Arikainyo Vatane inamavune ai!”
Naije Yesus apa arakove wayao vambinibe ware, “Are pirati no no wama yasyine so ti, indati apa ana dave maisyare somaisy?”
Are pi panakoeve no Amisye apa kawasae awa yasyin
Umba naije Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije wayao ensembe mansai ware, “Are pirati panakoeve no wama yasyin?”

Yesus po raura nanto mai pare, “Akarijo titi mine so manayanambe wo awa vambunine rarorono vatane mai, muno vatano awa vambunine no maije manayanambe wo vatane matutir. Wo vatane mansantitidi indamu ubeta awa bekere rai, weramu taune wo taune mansaura ware, ‘reamamo reamo vatano wanuije maeranande kobe.’

Weramu weapamo wabemo wabe taije maisy inya. Yara vatano rui pirati panakoeve no wapa yasyin, syare po taune atantona maisyare vatano mamaun wemaisy. Muno vatano rui pirati be akarive, syare opamo panapatambe vatane mai tenambe.
Arakove, no mine vone so vatano panakoe tuna pisyi bayave, muno vatano kaijinta wanapatambe ai. Weramu wamamo wansasye. Ribe akarive wasai muno syanapatambe wasai tavon.
Vatano wanui wonayo Rinai ti wo inave tatugadi, weramu weapamo wapo inapaya ramu, yara watavondijo Rinai tutir.
Maisyare omai ti, Syo wasapatimu indamu wabe akarive, maisyare muno Sya Injaya po inapatimu indamu ibe akarive.
Indati watantuna wapisyisyo inatavon arono ide ibe akarive mine vone so rai. Muno watantuna no kursijo ntiti, wabe akarive susyo Israel abusyinara eane jirume mansai tenambe.”
Yesus daura to pare Petrus indati po amamarave

Yesus po raura Petrus ai pare, “Simon, Simon. Anakakai Akoe po Amisye anajo indamu varore raugaje ai indamu po wea tenambe wasatopano wapa anave Rinaije rai, maisyare muno vatane po gandum rarayan ti ama ine ransopo ama kea rai wemaisy.

Weramu ibe sambayambe Simon winai, indamu vemo nyo nya anave Rinaije rapaya kobe inya, yara kavinta nakato umba nyakare Rinai. Muno arono nyakare Rinai to, weamo syare nyo nya arakove so awa anave raijaseo mbambunin akato tavon.”

Weramu Petrus po raura akananto Yesus ai pare, “Injae, risyamo indati syo napaya ramu! Yara syanatatayaube indamu risuiri natavon, weti vatane wo naugave siso no tanoano makova rai, weamo ritavondi imakova. Muno vatane wo naubaisy, weamo syare rikakaijo natavon.”
Umba Yesus po raura nanto Petrus ai pare, “Petrus, Syo raura tugaive, namane so mangkuere pana kokebe rainy, winyamo indati nyo inamamaravea susye mandei.”
Indati vatano mine vone so wo Yesus apa arakove mawatambe

Umba Yesus po manajo pare, “Wusyinoe arono Syo wasatutir indamu wapo Ayao Kove ravovo vatane mai, Syo wasanyao syare vemo wapo doije, ingkujawane, ajo kokome inta raugav inya. Arono naije ana inta meweno wasai rako jewena e?” Wo raura akananto Yesus ai ware, “Jewena.”

Umba Yesus po raura akananto mai pare, “Weramu soamo nsasye, weti wapo doije muno ingkujawane raugav wapa unanui anya rai. Muno are nyirati nya omake meweno nai, weamo nyo nya ansuno waravainye inta ramavun dati umba nyo ama doije veano omake inta ramavun namarom inda nyo raugav.
Weye Ayao Amisye ama ana mo rinaurairive omamo indati mamaisy, wemi mo ratoe no taiso: ‘Opamo ato siso vatano ukakainoanive mansai.’ Tugae, kavinta nakato urairije umaso indati mamaisy.”
Yesus apa arakove wo raura ware, “Injae, winyerade, wama omake mamo jiruma.” Umba Yesus po raura akananto mai pare, “Mamai to.”
Yesus sambayambe no Pukamo Saitun
Yesus puje Yerusalem raora, umba poroto no Pukamo Saitun maisyare muno masyote anteter porotove wemaisy. Apa arakove utavondi Ai tavon.
Arono unanta no Pukamo Saitun, Yesus po raura nanto Apa arakove mai pare, “Wasambayambe indamu vemo ana mo wasatopane mo wasakep inya!”
Yesus poroto gwaravaindi, umba Po apa vukane ranteter no kopa umba be sambayambe.
Pare, “Sya Injae, wimayar, syare Nyo siurije so raveto inaora. Weramu vemo wintavono Sya bekere rai nora, yara Injae nya bekere bo rai.”
Umba naije naito Amisye inta aroron ti de Yesus ai po vambunine raugaje Ai.
Yesus anuga nseo majeve ti be sambayambe vambunimbe. Apa mamoane ngkaputin nsororop maisyare muno mavu maje ramaisy.
Be sambayambea mewen, umba Yesus pakare no Apa arakovo utavondi aije mai. Po maen unaki, weye manimaumbe yava manakea mayondi.
Yesus po raura mai pare, “Wabeanimaibe wanaki? Wasea! Syare wasambayambe indamu vemo ana mo wasatopane mo wasakep inya!”
Naito Yahudi wo Yesus aijar
Arono Yesus payaowa nene, naije vatano wanui ude, muno Yudas, opamo Yesus apa arakovo abusyinara eane rurum inta pije, po unanuije rarorono mai. Umba Yudas de Yesus ai po anu.
Yesus po raura nanto ai pare, “Yudas, mbeanimaibe nyo Arikainyo Vatan rinanu? Weye nyare nyo inamavun!”
Yesus apa arakovo utavondi aije wo raura ware, “Injae, nyare reamo vatane umaso maperam omake rai je?”
Umba arakove inta po apa omake veano vatano panapatambe syeno titi aije amarikoamo anem ngkove raotar ti mpatimu.
Weramu Yesus po raura akananto mai pare, “Weinya!” Umba Po vatane umawe amarikoamo uma mpatimugoe raugakananto no akato ti nsauman.

Umba Yesus po raura nanto syeno akokoe utantuna no Yavaro Amisye raije nawe, akarijo naito Yahudi wo Yavaro Amisye ramane nawe, akarijo Yahudije nawe mai, weye ude ware wo aijar. Pare, “Risyamo vatano mamune inta pi Risye ramu. Ti wabeanimaibe wade irati omake muno kaije rautan indamu wapo inaijar?

Masyote anteter rituna no wapa yasyin no Yavaro Amisye ama uga, weramu wapo inaijare ramu. Weramu soamo varore raugaje wasai to. Wapo inaijaro namane yasyine so rai, omamo Anakakai Akoe apa ana dave mije.”
Petrus po Yesus amamarave
Umba wo Yesus aijar, wo augaveta no syeno titi apa yavar, muno Petrus dijat apa vavane no mai.
Umba vatane wo taname raon no yavare umawe ama wanijate rai, umba utantuna rakiani, muno Petrus tuna irati matavon.

Wanya arikainyo manapatambe syeno titi aije inta mo Petrus aen tuna no taname ama tuga. Taname ama vare mba nanto Petrus amune rai, weti wanya so mo amune rayasir kobe, umba mo raura mare, “Sopamo tavondijo Yesus aije inta pi sop.”
Weramu Petrus po Yesus amamarave pare, “Syantukambe vatane wato ai!”
Kavinta umba vatano kaijinta po Petrus aen, umba po raura pare, “Winyamo vatano tavondijo Yesus aije pi winy!” Weramu Petrus po raura akananto ai pare, “Risya jewena!”
Petrus tuna vavaijo uma amije intabo ai, umba vatano kaijinta de soowato ai pare, “Winyamo vatano Galilea, weti tugae rave winyamo vatan watavono Yesus aije inta pi winy ivae.”
Umba Petrus po raura akananto ai pare, “Syantukambe nya ana ndaura so rai!” Arono Petrus payaowa nene, naije kobe mangkuere kokebe.
Umba Amisy Yesus sarirae po aerananto. Umba Petrus aemeno Yesus apa ana daura umawe rai pare, “Mangkuere kokebe rainy, indati nyo inamamarave susye mandei.”
Umba Petrus puje poyo dave.
Vatane wanaikebe Yesus ai muno wo anepati
Naije naito wo Yesus aman wanaikebe Ai muno wo anepati.
Wo amune ratavano ansune vasye rai umba wo anajo ware, “Winyamo anawae pi Winy, weamo Nyo vatano po nanepate so apa tame raura kakavimbe reansai!”
Umba wo Yesus akaajian dave.
Yesus te no Anugano Akari Akokoe Yahudi mansamun
Awatan ngko dave, akarijo Yahudi nawe, syeno akokoe nawe, kuruno Yahudi nawe, wanugan umba wo Yesus augavere te no mansamun indamu wo akanijo Apa ayao kakaije rai.
Umba wo anajo ware, “Reamare Nyo raura kakavimbe reansai: Winyamo Mesiasa pi Win dako?” Weramu Yesus po raura akananto mai pare, “Ranivara Syo raura kakavimbe wasai, weamo wapanave Inaije ramu.
Muno ranivara Syo wasanajo, weamo indati wapo ana inta raura akanande Rinaije ramu.
Weramu kavinta nakato umba Risy, Arikainyo Vatan, ituna no Amisyo Bambunin Dave anem ngkove rai.”

Umba akarijo akokoe Yahudi wo raura tenambe ware, “Maisyare omai ti, Winyamo Arikainyo Amisye pi Winy e?” Yesus po raura akananto mai pare, “Sya tamo wadanajo mi taune wadaura to, ti syare tugae Risy ivae.”

Umba wo raura ware, “Wandaniv Yesus taune po apa ayao kakaije raurawa wandanaun to pare Opamo Arikainyo Amisye pa! Weti vemo wamo vatano kaijo wo aura tantunawije mawainde akato nora, weye wamo Apa ayao kakaije umaso ranaun to.”
